test.description: Run quiet test suite and report failures
test.template: Run `make -s test` and report any errors concisely with zero conversational filler.

build.template: Check build status using quiet flags, filtering output to errors and warnings only.

arch.description: Lookup specific architecture section from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
arch.template: Query docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for section $ARGUMENTS using grep/sed line ranges. Return only the requested technical details.
